text:
tess: Dropped a compact prototype for the Private setup wizard's connectivity step. It runs a couple of short probes and offers suggested fixes + copyable commands. Looking for UX + accessibility quick pass before we flip the flag. Figma: https://figma.redwood/preflight-compact

viktor: Love the compactness. Question: should results appear inline below the step title (collapsed) or in a small right-side flyout? Inline helps scans, flyout gives space for logs.

tess: Leaning inline collapsed by default; add a "View full diagnostics" link that opens a flyout for power users. Keeps primary flow simple.

anya: Copy: change button label to "Run connectivity test" (clearer than "probe"). Expanded panel title: "Suggested fixes & test commands".

sam: From infra: include a confidence indicator (High/Med/Low) and a short note that probes are unauthenticated and ephemeral. Also set probe timeout to 3s and show elapsed time.

mia: A11y: announce results with aria-live=polite, ensure accordion toggles have aria-expanded/controls, and provide a pre role="log" for detailed output. Also ensure copy buttons announce success.

tess: Good catches. I'll add aria-live and the role="log" block. Also will respect prefers-reduced-motion for the spinner.

viktor: Docs: include two snippet types: a curl for HTTP checks and a generic tcp check (nc/socat). Preface with: "Sample Linux commands; adapt for your OS/firewall."

anya: UX microcopy variants to A/B test for the short result line: A) "Connectivity check failed likely firewall or DNS." B) "We couldn't reach the service. Common causes: firewall, DNS, NAT." Short vs explicit.

sam: UX detail: show a subtle status icon on the stepper (green check or warning) after a run so users can scan wizard progress. For failures, tooltip links to expand.

mia: Keyboard checklist: tab to Run button, Enter/Space to activate, after run focus moves to the result summary, ESC closes flyout and returns focus to the toggle. Test with screen readers.

tess: I'll update the mock with these changes and add a short Loom showing keyboard flow. Planning to enable feature-flag "compact-preflight" on staging after that.

kb-bot: feature-flag "compact-preflight" enabled on staging at 1880012398.

viktor: Telemetry events to add: `preflight.test_run`, `preflight.copy_command`, `preflight.open_full_diagnostics`, `preflight.request_support`.

anya: Approve to ship to staging once mock + a11y notes are in. Will coordinate small internal keyboard usability check (3 people).

tess: Thanks all — iterating now :thumbsup:
